content: Neon = serverless Postgres only (branching, scale-to-zero), no built-in auth. Supabase = Postgres + bundled auth/realtime/storage BaaS. PlanetScale = Vitess/MySQL, lost free tier, min $39/mo. Vercel Postgres was retired Dec 2024, migrated to Neon; Neon is now Vercel's native Marketplace Postgres integration.
